status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 36% fewer than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Baidoa and Puntland.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 36 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Baidoa og Puntland.

summary.en: Al-Shabaab continues probe attacks testing Kenya's border defenses while militia forces killed eight Somali civilians near the Kenya-Ethiopia border. Ugandan troops are withdrawing from Somalia, prompting security concerns around Mogadishu, and Uganda denies that its soldiers were killed in the country. Somalia joined 17 nations in condemning an Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital and a Somali refugee woman was killed by Houthi shelling of a camp in Lahj. Rainstorms in Lower Shabelle killed a mother and two children, and protests erupted in Hirshabelle over the regional election as al-Shabaab seized Coomaad. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Al-Shabaab fortsetter med provoserende angrep som tester Kenyas grenseforsvar, mens militsstyrker drepte åtte somaliske sivile nær grensen mellom Kenya og Etiopia. Ugandiske tropper trekker seg tilbake fra Somalia, noe som gir sikkerhetsbekymringer rundt Mogadishu, og Uganda benekter at deres soldater ble drept i landet. Somalia sluttet seg til 17 nasjoner i å fordømme et israelsk angrep på et sykehus i Gaza, og en somalisk flyktningkvinne ble drept av houthiene som skjøt missiler mot en leir i Lahj. Regnstormer i Lower Shabelle drepte en mor og to barn, og protester brøt ut i Hirshabelle over det regionale valget da al-Shabaab tok kontroll over Coomaad. Konflikten førte til 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
